To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the newly synthesized spirooxindolopyrrolotiazole derivatives 4k showed the highest anti-cancer activity against MCF-7 (15.32 ± 0.02) and K562 leukemia (14.74 ± 0.7) cell lines.
the newly synthesized compounds 4a–4n were screened for their anti-cancer activity against breast cancer MCF-7 cell line and K562-leukaemia.
a series of spiro-oxindole derivatives were synthesized and evaluated for their in vitro anti-cancer activity against breast cancer MCF-7, and leukemia K562 cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, synthesis and evaluation of a series of new spiro-oxindole derivatives as anti-cancer agents.
the synthesis of new di-spirocyclic compounds incorporating a pyrrolothiazole ring and an oxindole ring.
the synthesis of novel spirooxindoles and the investigation of their anticancer activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study has led to the synthesis and characterization of new compounds that have been tested against two different types of cancer cells.
the compounds with an electron-donating group at the 4-position on the phenyl ring and an electron-withdrawing group at the 6-position on the phenol ring showed the most potent activity.

the 1,3-cycloaddition reactions of an azomithine ylide generated in situ from isatin and 4-methyl-2-thiazolinecarboxylicacid to 2,6-disubstituted cyclohexanones is an efficient and facile approach to di-spiroheterocycles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a series of new spiro compounds were synthesized, characterized, screened, and investigated by molecular docking.
the newly synthesized compounds 4a-n were found to be active against the tested cell lines.

the synthesized compounds have a significant anti-cancer activity against MCF-7 cells, K562-leukemic cells and the molecular docking results support the biological activity of the synthesized compounds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesized compounds can be used as a new class of anticancer agents.
the 1,3-cycloaddition reaction of azomethine and thiazolidines with cyclohexanones is an excellent method for the synthesis of di-spiro compounds.
the newly synthesized compounds are potent inhibitors of MCF-7 cells and K562 leukemia.
